messages:
jia: Heads-up — after today's router change I'm seeing two issues: trailing-slash canonicalization seems fine for route matching, but query params are being reordered and presigned URLs break (sig+expires get duplicated). Anyone else seeing this?
noah: saw the same in logs. cache key normalization is canonicalizing query by sorting and deduping, but some clients depend on original order for signed URLs. also noticed duplicate `sig` when we attempt to merge presigned query override.
devx: deploy-bot: release/edge-router v2.14.1 deployed to prod 3 minutes ago :rocket:
sam: This is expected from the current canonicalization step — we sort/uniq queries to reduce cache cardinality. For signed URLs we should special-case keys used for auth instead of globally reordering. Proposing route-level controls: `preserve_query_order` (bool) and `signed_query_keys` (list).
maria: Agree with special-casing. Suggest we implement two changes: 1) always strip trailing slash for matching but keep a flag to rewrite path back if upstream needs it, 2) for queries: default behavior stays (sort+dedupe) but route config can set `query_mode: preserve|canonicalize`, and `signed_keys: ["sig","expires"]` to avoid reordering/deduping those keys. This keeps cache benefits for most routes.
jia: Another related thing — header injection for canary routing (`x-canary`) is happening after the rewrite stage now, so middleware that reads headers during rewrite misses it. Is header injection ordered intentionally?
sam: It was an oversight. We inject route headers at the end of pipeline. We should move header injection earlier (pre-rewrite) for header-driven rewrites, but that might change rewrite semantics for some legacy routes. I think we need an explicit `header_injection_stage: pre_rewrite|post_rewrite` route option.
maria: If we allow pre-rewrite injection we must add a telemetry tag so we can tell whether a request took the pre- or post-injection path. Otherwise debugging will be annoying. Add `rewrite_stage` span attribute and emit metric `router.rewrite.stage`.
noah: Also flagging a security corner: if we preserve query order for signed URLs we must ensure we never accidentally log full query to traces unless redaction rule applied (sig/expires). Add logging redaction for `signed_keys`.
sam: Draft patch for route schema (pseudo):
```json
{
  "route": {
    "match": "/v1/foo",
    "path_normalization": { "trim_trailing_slash": true, "rewrite_back": false },
    "query_mode": "canonicalize", // or "preserve"
    "signed_query_keys": ["sig","expires"],
    "header_injection_stage": "pre_rewrite"
  }
}
```
noah: LGTM. Also include a small e2e test harness with an actual presigned URL and ensure cache key differs when `preserve` is off vs on.
devx: Rolling back v2.14.1 on prod/edge-3 and leaving a canary on staging. I'll open a short PR for the schema + tests and request review from sam/maria/noah.
jia: Thanks — will add a failing integration test to catch duplication cases.
noah: I'll add telemetry + redaction changes. :+1:
deploy-bot: redeploy edge-3 to previous version completed :white_check_mark:
jia: OK thanks all, reassigning to sam for the route schema PR and staging rollout.
thread_summary: discussion about order of query canonicalization vs preserving presigned URL params, proposal for route-level flags (query_mode, signed_query_keys), header injection ordering, telemetry and redaction requirements, rollback and next steps
